mechanism: Opposing pharmacodynamic effects: armodafinil promotes wakefulness via dopamine/norepinephrine pathways while valerian promotes sedation via GABA/adenosine mechanisms, potentially reducing efficacy of both agents.
action: Separate dosing times by several hours; monitor patient for reduced therapeutic effect of armodafinil and counsel on potential CNS effects; consider alternative sleep aid if armodafinil efficacy is compromised.
